verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a non-mutating `pulumi preview` (plan step) and numeric CLI exit codes intended for scripts and CI/CD systems. The Automation API runs Pulumi programs programmatically without the CLI, and a community user reports running Pulumi in all their CI/CD pipelines. That supports the core non-interactive preview/deploy workflow, but the pack never shows saved plan artifacts being produced and then applied, nor non-interactive approval flags. Missing for 10: documented saved-plan artifact output and consumption on apply, documented skip-confirmation/approval flags for CI, a first-party CI plan/apply guide.
